meta.synchronization_note: RFC 5545 sec 3.8.5.3 declares the recurrence set undefined when DTSTART is not synchronized with the recurrence rule. Cases with dtstart_synchronized=false record observed cross-implementation convention in that undefined region, NOT a conformance requirement. Consume them as interop data; do not cite them as spec violations.
meta.validity_note: rule_valid is computed by src/validity.py from RFC 5545 3.3.10 MUST NOT constraints and value ranges, independently of any expander. It is a third, separate dimension: rule validity, DTSTART synchronization, and implementation agreement are different questions. Agreement on a rule the spec prohibits is not evidence of conformance.
